ios.notes:
Liquid Glass you can see through.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.1

Fixed
- Liquid Glass: the tab bar and the mini player are now clear glass, so what scrolls underneath shows through. In 7.3.0 they came out dark and opaque.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.3.0...ios-v7.3.1

windows.notes:
Find any setting in seconds, a cleaner Up next, and a shuffle that goes through everything.

Duotone for Windows 7.2.8

New
- Search in Settings: type a name or what it does ("fullscreen", "tray"), and it opens the right section and lights up the setting.

Improved
- Up next shows just the queue. The Now playing row above it repeated the player bar.
- Shuffle goes through the whole list before repeating, even when you shuffle again or restart Duotone.

Fixed
- The glow under the selected tab (Up next, Radio) and the dark shadow under a friend's cover are gone.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/win-v7.2.5...win-v7.2.8

windowsPreview.notes:
Duotone Preview 0.2.0

New
- Social redesigned: conversations without a frame, the friend you're listening with in a resizable panel on the right, the window takes their cover's colour, and messages, rows and panels animate in and out.
- The Preview now updates itself (installed copy only).

Improved
- Panels, dialogs, notices, menus and the selection bar slide in and out instead of popping.

Fixed
- Settings restored from your account after launch (3D cover, two-tone covers, layout, colour) now apply right away.
- The Preview no longer asks you to install the Duotone update.
- Friend lists could jump far off screen while reordering.
